reason: negative side failed: preconditions accepted 1 of 15 unrelated states (diverged seed 0 resolves to 'merge'); a precondition set that accepts unrelated states is a defect. refused_program.intent: sync with upstream, resolve the dependency-file conflict by starting from upstream's version and re-adding the lines the local side added

preconditions.name: branches_diverged
preconditions.probe: git rev-list --left-right --count HEAD...{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} | awk '$1 > 0 && $2 > 0 { found = 1 } END { exit !found }'

preconditions.description: there are no uncommitted changes before starting the sync
preconditions.name: worktree_clean

preconditions.description: a merge is not already in progress
preconditions.name: no_merge_in_progress

preconditions.description: exactly one file was changed by both sides since the merge base, and it exists on both sides
preconditions.name: one_common_changed_file
preconditions.probe:
base=$(git merge-base HEAD {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}) || exit 1
files=$(comm -12 \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" HEAD | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} | tr '\0' '\n' | sort))
[ "$(printf '%s\n' "$files" | grep -c .)" -eq 1 ] || exit 1
path=$(printf '%s\n' "$files" | head -n 1)
git cat-file -e "HEAD:$path"
git cat-file -e "{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}:$path"
